<objective>
Swap the app's gatekeeper from the shared kiosk passcode to member sessions, inside the
one seam the v1.0 code built for exactly this swap.

Purpose: `currentMember` in `src/server/auth/passcode-gate.ts` says in its own header that
callers never see where an identity came from. This plan cashes that in. It is the phase
tracer: a real password in the database, a real hash check, a real session row, a real
cookie and a real signed-in request, proven end to end before any task builds on it.

Output: migration `0003_members_and_sessions.sql`, `session-store.ts`, a rewritten
`currentMember`, `POST /api/sign-in`, and the removal of the passcode path. Two new test files.
</objective>

<scope_note>
**Task 1 is wider than the usual file ceiling, on purpose.** Replacing the old `Passcode` type
with `Member` means every route and every test app literal has to follow in the same commit,
since the compiler will not accept a half-moved tree. Most touched files take a one-line edit;
the real work sits in `session-store.ts`, `credentials.ts` and the migration.
</scope_note>
